title: Installation Process Possibly Broken for Mac
body:
Followed setup instructions on a Mac M1 and while Grafana pulls up, the API server and the frontend are both "unable to connect".

Everything worked until I ran `bin/probod`.

Configs:
$ go version
go version go1.24.1 darwin/arm64
$ node -v
v22.14.0
$ nvm current
v22.14.0
$ npm -v
10.9.2
$ docker -v
Docker version 27.5.1, build 9f9e405

```
{"time":"2025-03-19T10:55:38.321698-04:00","level":"INFO","msg":"metrics server shutdown","version":"unknown","environment":"prod"}
panic: cannot migrate database schema: cannot apply migration &{20240319T121300Z ALTER TABLE tasks ALTER COLUMN time_estimate DROP NOT NULL;}: cannot execute migration: ERROR: relation "tasks" does not exist (SQLSTATE 42P01)
```
author: MattCaleb165

comments.body: Thanks for reporting us this issue. You can pull the main a fix as been implemented.
